tooltip.crashy.glue.1: Bonds blocks into one rigid structure.
tooltip.crashy.glue.2: Off-hand: every block you place is glued automatically.
tooltip.crashy.glue.3: Right-click: glue a block · Sneak + right-click: dissolve the group.
tooltip.crashy.launcher.2: Right-click an object to grab it, hold to charge (max power 10).
tooltip.crashy.launcher.3: Sneak + right-click to put it down.
tooltip.crashy.activator.1: Turns a glued build into a real rigid body.
tooltip.crashy.activator.2: Activated by empty-hand right-click or a redstone signal.
tooltip.crashy.activator.3: Right-click a physics object with this item to switch it back off.
tooltip.crashy.saver.1: Records the build it is attached to.
tooltip.crashy.saver.2: Empty hand: save · Blueprint in hand: copy onto it.
tooltip.crashy.saver.3: Sneak + right-click: wipe what is stored.
tooltip.crashy.blueprint.1: Right-click a block face to stamp the build out.
tooltip.crashy.blueprint.empty: Empty — fill it at a Build Saver
message.crashy.glue.limit: The glued group has reached its size limit
message.crashy.activator.already: This activator has already been used
message.crashy.activator.nothing: Nothing to activate — glue the build first
message.crashy.activator.too_many: Too many blocks (limit %s) — glue a smaller structure
message.crashy.activator.failed: Sable refused to assemble this structure
message.crashy.deactivate.empty: This object has no blocks left
message.crashy.saver.nothing: Nothing to save — glue a build to this block
message.crashy.launcher.not_physics: That is not a physics object
settings.crashy.mode.instant.desc: Everything inside the blast radius shatters, whatever it is made of.
settings.crashy.mode.realistic.desc: The harder the hit, the more breaks. Planks scatter where cobblestone only chips.
settings.crashy.mode.indestructible.desc: Nothing breaks. Objects still fly and bounce off the world.
settings.crashy.no_permission: Only operators can change these settings
